elements.label: Email Address
elements.behavior: Account identifier; must match an existing wxKanban user.

elements.label: Password
elements.behavior: Secret credential; the eye icon toggles local visibility only.

elements.label: Sign In
elements.behavior: Authenticates; on success lands admins on Dashboard, members on My Tasks; wrong credentials error and repeated failures lock the account.

elements.label: Forgot password?
elements.behavior: Starts the email-based password reset flow.

elements.label: Register here
elements.behavior: Opens the new-company sign-up wizard; not for joining an existing company.

elements.label: Jira/Monday/Asana/Trello chips
elements.behavior: Shortcut to begin by connecting a PM system; most users connect later in PM Integrations.

elements.label: Sidebar navigation
elements.behavior: Links to every app area; padlocked items are outside the current plan.

elements.label: New
elements.behavior: Creates a project inline (admins only).

elements.label: All projects
elements.behavior: Opens the full Projects list.

elements.label: Summary cards
elements.behavior: Read-only headline numbers: Current Plan/seats, Team Members, Active Projects, Hours This Week.

elements.label: Project card
elements.behavior: Per-project lifecycle phase progress, outstanding tasks, and document quick-links; click the name to open the project.

elements.label: Document links
elements.behavior: Open a project's generated docs; 'not created' means not yet generated, a date means it exists.

elements.label: Edit audit type
elements.behavior: Sets the compliance framework the project is audited against.

elements.label: Project Proposals
elements.behavior: Captured future-project ideas with statuses; Create Project turns an accepted proposal into a project.

elements.label: Pending Tasks
elements.behavior: Per-project unfinished task counts (NEW / IN-PROG / TOTAL).

elements.label: System Health
elements.behavior: Live app/database status, uptime, latency, connections; Refresh re-checks.

elements.label: Upgrade Plan
elements.behavior: Prompts to upgrade for Consultant-only Time & Billing / Reports features.

elements.label: Phase filter tabs
elements.behavior: Narrow the list to projects in a lifecycle phase (All/Design/Implementation/QA/Human/Beta/Release).

elements.label: Search projects
elements.behavior: Filters the list by project name as you type.

elements.label: Sort (Updated/Created/Name)
elements.behavior: Orders the list; Updated is default.

elements.label: Project row
elements.behavior: Shows phase badge and scope summary; click to open the project.

elements.label: New Project
elements.behavior: Creates a new project (name + description).

screens.title: Inside a project
screens.nav: Dashboard or Projects > pick a project

elements.label: Audit dropdown
elements.behavior: Chooses the compliance framework to audit against (No Audit/GDPR/HIPAA/HITRUST/SOC2).

elements.label: Archive
elements.behavior: Archives the project after confirmation.

elements.label: Delete
elements.behavior: Deletes the project after confirmation; destructive.

elements.label: VIEWS: Kanban
elements.behavior: Scopes laid out as cards per lifecycle phase.

elements.label: VIEWS: Matrix
elements.behavior: Scopes as a table with a status column per phase.

elements.label: VIEWS: Stack
elements.behavior: The project's technology stack & style (inherited from company Stack Profiles unless overridden).

elements.label: VIEWS: Theme
elements.behavior: The project's visual theme (inherited from company Theme Profiles unless overridden).

elements.label: VIEWS: Bug Reports
elements.behavior: Bug reports for the project; Install/get endpoint seeds a bug-trapping scope if none exist.

elements.label: Lifecycle tab
elements.behavior: Lifecycle report: scope distribution across the six phases, shown with charts.

elements.label: Development Plan tab
elements.behavior: Build roadmap: what's built/next/blocking, dependency map, critical path.

elements.label: Portfolio Analyzer tab
elements.behavior: Searches other projects for overlapping scopes ('Has the company already built this?'); reuse instead of rebuild; Download PDF.

elements.label: Compliance tab
elements.behavior: Enable compliance frameworks and review audit config, documents, tasks, and reports.

elements.label: Learnings tab
elements.behavior: Compound-learnings report of decisions, fixes, and controls after work is done.

elements.label: Kit tab
elements.behavior: Downloadable AI-ready development environment (kit) for the project, with version and status.

elements.label: Search scopes
elements.behavior: Filters scope cards by text.

elements.label: All statuses filter
elements.behavior: Filters scopes by state.

elements.label: Show deferred
elements.behavior: Includes scopes that were intentionally set aside.

elements.label: Scope card
elements.behavior: A unit of work with number, title, task count, state badge, progress bar, and Scope Process Flow / Scope Analysis links.

elements.label: Sync now
elements.behavior: Immediately pulls assigned tasks from all connected PM systems.

elements.label: All sources filter
elements.behavior: Limits tasks to Jira/Monday/Asana/Trello/Internal.

elements.label: All priorities filter
elements.behavior: Shows only Critical/High/Medium/Low tasks.

elements.label: All statuses filter
elements.behavior: Shows only Open/In progress/Completed/Orphaned tasks.

elements.label: Sort
elements.behavior: Orders by Recently updated/Due date/Priority/Title with a direction toggle.

elements.label: Empty state
elements.behavior: 'No tasks yet' with a prompt to connect a PM system when nothing has synced.

elements.label: Project filter
elements.behavior: Scopes the whole page to one project or All Projects.

elements.label: Total Tasks tile
elements.behavior: Count of all tasks in the assigned queue.

elements.label: Past Due tile
elements.behavior: Tasks past their due date (amber).

elements.label: 30+ Day Aging tile
elements.behavior: Tasks untouched 30+ days (red).

elements.label: Compliance tile
elements.behavior: Count of compliance-flagged tasks.

elements.label: Assigned Work Queue
elements.behavior: Your tasks across projects with one-click time tracking.

elements.label: Invoice-Ready Billable Preview
elements.behavior: Billable hours in a chosen date range; a preview of what could be invoiced.

elements.label: Compliance Review Panel
elements.behavior: Lists compliance-flagged tasks so non-compliant work isn't billed.

elements.label: Invite Member
elements.behavior: Adds a person by email + role; emails them an invite to set a password; uses a plan seat.

elements.label: Search / All-Active-Inactive
elements.behavior: Filters the member table by name/email or status.

elements.label: Role dropdown
elements.behavior: Sets a member as Admin (full control) or Manager.

elements.label: Language dropdown
elements.behavior: Sets the member's interface language.

elements.label: Status
elements.behavior: Active (can sign in) or Inactive (retained but blocked).

elements.label: Row actions
elements.behavior: Edit member, resend invite, reset/manage access, remove (remove confirms).

elements.label: Invite Consulting Company
elements.behavior: Starts an engagement with an external firm that doesn't use seats and sees only assigned projects.

elements.label: Consultant card actions
elements.behavior: Open / Pause / Disable / End the engagement; Pause/Disable/End change the firm's access.

elements.label: Connect (per system)
elements.behavior: Starts OAuth2 authorization for Jira/Monday/Asana/Trello; access is stored encrypted.

elements.label: System card state
elements.behavior: Shows Not connected or connected per tool.

elements.label: View My Tasks
elements.behavior: Opens the synced task list (My Tasks).

elements.label: Generate Invoice
elements.behavior: Builds a PDF invoice from billable time for a project/date range; marks entries invoiced to prevent double billing.

elements.label: Total Invoices
elements.behavior: How many invoices exist.

elements.label: Total Revenue
elements.behavior: Summed value of invoices.

elements.label: Sent Invoices
elements.behavior: How many have been sent.

elements.label: Invoice History
elements.behavior: Each invoice with client, amount, and status.

elements.label: Time Reports / Project Reports
elements.behavior: Switches between time analytics and project-progress analytics.

elements.label: Date Range (Start/End)
elements.behavior: Scopes the report to a window; required before data shows.

elements.label: Export CSV
elements.behavior: Downloads the current report as CSV.

elements.label: Time by Team Member
elements.behavior: Hours logged per person in the selected range.

elements.label: Project dropdown
elements.behavior: Projects with a captured Stack & Style, eligible to promote; each tagged with its type.

elements.label: Promote
elements.behavior: Makes the selected project's stack the company-wide default for its application type.

elements.label: Profiles (Web/Desktop/Mobile)
elements.behavior: Current company default stack per type; a project with its own stack overrides it.

elements.label: Profiles (Web/Desktop/Mobile)
elements.behavior: Current company default theme per type, or 'Not set' (falls back to wxKanban default).

elements.label: Save a theme from a project
elements.behavior: Shortcut into a project's Theme tab where 'Save as company theme' sets the default.

elements.label: Question rows
elements.behavior: Click to expand and reveal each answer.

elements.label: Ask box
elements.behavior: Submits a new question to the wxKanban team for inclusion in the FAQ.

elements.label: Plan cards
elements.behavior: Selecting Single User/Small-Medium Business/Consultant/Enterprise sets which plan the feature badges reflect; your plan is default.

elements.label: Included / Upgrade required badge
elements.behavior: Whether the selected plan includes that feature.

elements.label: Feature card
elements.behavior: Describes an app area with a How-to tip and its availability.

elements.label: Company Name
elements.behavior: Organization name shown app-wide as the active tenant.

elements.label: Billing Email
elements.behavior: General company contact email.

elements.label: Consultant Invoice Email
elements.behavior: Destination for B2B invoices.

elements.label: Billing Address / Phone
elements.behavior: Postal and phone billing contacts.

elements.label: Save Company Info
elements.behavior: Stores changes to company information.

elements.label: Subscription & Payment
elements.behavior: Shows Plan and Status and lets you review the plan and update a card if payment failed.
